sources.title: easy_sign/README_en.md at main · ai-forever/easy_sign · GitHub
sources.snippet: About the project Easy_sign uses a machine learning model to recognize Russian sign language gestures. The model was trained on ~180,000 examples of Russian sign language gestures. Approximately 20,000 of which are taken from the Slovo dataset.
